title: FRED / ALFRED dual-API macroeconomic observational source
context: The platform requires PIT-correct U.S. macro regime context complementary to CFTC aggregate positioning. FRED exposes two API generations with non-overlapping responsibilities.

dual_api.v1_alfred: Granular series/release operations, ALFRED realtime/vintage PIT reconstruction, incremental sync
dual_api.v2: Release-level bulk current histories via /fred/v2/release/observations only
dual_api.prohibition: V2 current history must never substitute for historical PIT queries

decision.observation_admission: OBSERVED / CAPTURED / VALIDATED / QUALITY_CHARACTERIZED — not ADMITTED by default
decision.registry: Bounded Tier 1 canonical indicator registry; no ingest-all-FRED crawler
decision.cftc_interoperability: CrossAssetRegimeContext joins independent macro and positioning clocks
decision.licensing: Preserve copyright_id; internal research scope; flag third-party redistribution review
decision.security: V1 api_key query param and V2 Bearer header must be redacted from logs and evidence

consequences: Historical backtests fail closed when ALFRED/V1 PIT path unavailable
Release calendar aids scheduling but is not available_time truth
V1/V2 reconciliation required for current-state consistency
Mixed V2 release updates must not publish incoherent snapshots
